conceptual_change: Transitioning from local price-volume exhaustion metrics to a broader trend-following regime indicator based on the 24-period rolling mean of vwap_distance. This mechanism captures sustained price divergence from the volume-weighted average price as a confirmation of momentum direction, diverging from previous volatility-adjusted mean reversion models.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
